title: Docker Engine installs from the elicited apt channel: the observable repository source matches
asA: operator installing the container host on a fresh Ubuntu 24.04 or Debian 12 baseline
iWant: the shipped installer script to resolve the elicited docker-engine-channel answer into the apt sources entry actually written to the host, and to refuse any other value with a named error kind
soThat: a project verifying against test can trust the installed engine is on the pre-release channel; a project on stable can trust it is on the stable channel

acceptanceCriteria.description: With docker-engine-channel=stable, the installer writes an apt sources entry pointing at the vendor stable pool; the observable file at /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list carries the "stable" pool component; dpkg -s docker-ce reports a version from the stable pool. With docker-engine-channel=test, the same file carries the "test" component and dpkg -s reports a version from the test pool.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fresh Ubuntu 24.04 baseline with no prior docker-ce install
acceptanceCriteria.when: the installer script runs against the elicited channel
acceptanceCriteria.then: the apt sources file carries the elicited pool component and the installed docker-ce matches

acceptanceCriteria.description: The installer refuses any elicited docker-engine-channel value outside {stable, test} with a stable error kind DOCKER_ENGINE_CHANNEL_UNSUPPORTED naming the offered value and lists the accepted options in the message. No apt sources entry is written on refusal.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a docker-engine-channel elicit answer set to "nightly" (or any other unrecognised value)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the installer refuses with DOCKER_ENGINE_CHANNEL_UNSUPPORTED and no apt sources entry lands

acceptanceCriteria.description: Sources file content probe: after the installer script runs on the fixture VM, a shell probe reads /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list and asserts (a) the file exists, (b) the URI resolves to https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu (or /linux/debian) matching the OS, and (c) the pool component equals the elicited docker-engine-channel answer ("stable" or "test"). SIMULATE_STALE_SOURCES=true writes an incorrect pool value and the probe FAILS naming the observed and expected components.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fresh VM after the installer runs with docker-engine-channel=stable
acceptanceCriteria.when: the probe reads the sources file
acceptanceCriteria.then: the file exists, the URI matches, and the pool component equals "stable"

acceptanceCriteria.description: Keyring probe: /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg exists after the installer runs (the Docker Engine install steps place the keyring here per the Ubuntu install doc). SIMULATE_MISSING_KEYRING=true removes the file and the installer refuses on the next apt-get update with a stable error kind DOCKER_ENGINE_KEYRING_MISSING.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fresh VM after the installer runs
acceptanceCriteria.then: the file exists; SIMULATE_MISSING_KEYRING=true removes it and the installer refuses with DOCKER_ENGINE_KEYRING_MISSING

acceptanceCriteria.description: Idempotent install: running the installer script twice on the same VM does NOT duplicate the sources entry (a subsequent grep of /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list finds exactly one URI line), does NOT re-add the keyring, and returns exit 0 on the second run. The installer detects the existing install and short-circuits (docker-ce is up to date).
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fresh VM after the installer has already run once
acceptanceCriteria.when: the installer script runs a second time
acceptanceCriteria.then: the sources file has exactly one URI line; the keyring is unchanged; the second run exits 0
